verses.heading: Nephi₁’s Introduction ｢360｣
verses.text: I, Nephi, having been born of goodly parents, therefore I was taught somewhat in all the learning of my father; and having seen many afflictions in the course of my days, nevertheless, having been highly favored of the Lord in all my days; yea, having had a great knowledge of the goodness and the mysteries of God, therefore I make a record of my proceedings in my days.

verses.heading: Nephi₁’s Introduction ｢360｣
verses.text: Yea, I make a record in the language of my father, which consists of the learning of the Jews and the language of the Egyptians.

verses.heading: Nephi₁’s Introduction ｢360｣
verses.text: And I know that the record which I make is true; and I make it with mine own hand; and I make it according to my knowledge.

verses.heading: Lehi₁’s Commission
verses.text: For it came to pass in the commencement of the first year of the reign of Zedekiah, king of Judah, (my father, Lehi, having dwelt at Jerusalem in all his days); and in that same year there came many prophets, prophesying unto the people that they must repent, or the great city Jerusalem must be destroyed.

verses.heading: Lehi₁’s Commission
verses.text: Wherefore it came to pass that my father, Lehi, as he went forth prayed unto the Lord, yea, even with all his heart, in behalf of his people.
